title: Diálogo de saberes. Hacia la dignificación y vitalización de la pluralidad de conocimientos
summary: All living fabric is born from a warp of diverse threads. Thus, the dialogue of knowledges emerges as a praxis of encounter that challenges the boundaries of knowledge and opens epistemic and methodological intersections for inhabiting worlds of shared life. In this tapestry of voices, memories, territories, and experiences, rooted in Our America, knowledge springs from listening, diversity, and reciprocity, resisting epistemic extractivism to affirm an ethic of care, responsive co-authorship, and mutual learning. Ecosophy positions life as a shared horizon; knowledge and ignorance reveal the incompleteness of every perspective; epistemic justice and interculturality call for reimagining situated universities, capable of learning alongside territories and communities. This work weaves together resonances to vitalize the plurality of knowledges and cultivate alternative ways of living together, knowing, and caring for life.
